title: Famous companies and what's on their logo

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

symbol.match: Match each company to what's on its logo.

rows.label: Amazon
rows.symbol: an arrow curving from the first letter to the last, shaped like a smile
rows.hook: began as an online bookstore and grew into the world's biggest online marketplace

rows.label: McDonald's
rows.symbol: two golden arches forming a yellow M
rows.hook: serves Big Macs and Happy Meals at fast food restaurants around the globe

rows.label: BMW
rows.symbol: a blue-and-white checkered circle, taken from Bavaria's state colors
rows.hook: builds luxury cars and motorcycles and calls itself the ultimate driving machine

rows.label: Nike, Inc.
rows.symbol: a single curved checkmark, the Swoosh
rows.hook: sells sneakers and sportswear under the slogan "Just Do It"

rows.label: Toyota
rows.symbol: three overlapping ovals, two of them forming a letter T
rows.hook: makes the Prius hybrid and the Corolla, among the best-selling cars ever

rows.label: Adidas AG
rows.symbol: three slanted bars arranged into a mountain shape
rows.hook: makes sportswear and sneakers, and once teamed with rapper Kanye West on its Yeezy line

rows.label: Starbucks
rows.symbol: a twin-tailed mermaid inside a green circle
rows.hook: is the giant coffeehouse chain famous for Frappuccinos and pumpkin spice lattes

rows.label: Volkswagen
rows.symbol: one letter stacked over another inside a circle
rows.description: German automotive brand; manufacturing subsidiary of Volkswagen Group
rows.hook: makes the Beetle and the Golf, and its name means "people's car"

rows.label: Target Corporation
rows.symbol: a red bullseye, a ring around a solid dot
rows.hook: is the big-box retailer known for its red shopping carts and Sunday-circular deals

rows.label: Hyundai Motor Company
rows.symbol: a slanted letter H, said to show two people shaking hands
rows.hook: is a giant automaker from Seoul that makes the Elantra and Sonata

rows.label: Chevrolet
rows.symbol: a gold bowtie shape
rows.hook: makes the Corvette and Camaro and is a long-time General Motors brand

rows.label: Puma
rows.symbol: a big cat caught leaping in mid-stride
rows.hook: is a sportswear brand that sponsors sprinter Usain Bolt and makes suede sneakers

rows.label: Mercedes-Benz Group
rows.symbol: a three-pointed star inside a circle
rows.hook: is the luxury automaker behind the S-Class and Formula One's Silver Arrows

rows.label: FedEx
rows.symbol: a hidden white arrow tucked in the gap between two of its letters
rows.hook: is the overnight delivery company whose purple and orange trucks and planes carry packages worldwide

rows.label: Michelin
rows.symbol: a smiling figure built out of stacked white tires
rows.hook: is the French rubber company whose restaurant guide awards famous stars

rows.label: Pringles
rows.symbol: a mustached cartoon face wearing a bow tie
rows.hook: sells stackable potato crisps in a tall tube with the slogan "Once you pop, you can't stop"

rows.label: Toblerone
rows.symbol: a mountain peak with a bear hidden in its outline
rows.hook: is a Swiss chocolate bar with honey and almond nougat in a triangular box

rows.label: Baskin-Robbins
rows.symbol: pink letters that secretly spell out the number 31
rows.description: American multinational ice cream parlor chain
rows.hook: is an ice cream chain famous for offering a different flavor for every day of a month

rows.label: Lacoste
rows.symbol: a green crocodile
rows.description: French company specialized in ready-to-wear clothing
rows.hook: makes polo shirts and was founded by a French tennis champion nicknamed for a reptile

rows.label: Chupa Chups
rows.symbol: a daisy-shaped flower, designed by Salvador Dalí
rows.hook: makes lollipops on a stick, invented by a Spanish confectioner who wanted a mess-free treat
